column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:minilang module + the core `mini` word
# `mini <kind> <src> <opts?>` expands at the call site to the STANDARD
# The trailing `end` stops the generated word's forward collection, so
# kind-declared inputs always come from the STACK and tokens after the mini
# call are never stolen. Kinds: `re` (Go regexp match — subject from stack,
# match structure out) and `bf` (brainfuck — output String; `,` reads the
# stack input or opts.in). `MiniLang.register` installs AQL fns as new kinds;
# `MiniLang.kinds` lists them. NB backslashes in '…' strings need doubling
# ('\\d' below is the pattern \d) — backtick strings are backslash-safe.
aql:minilang import end  def r ("AbcD" mini re '[a-z]+') end  r.fst.m

column1: # §6  the `+name<delim>src<delim>` shortcut — terse lexer sugar for `mini name 'src'`.
#     The delimiter is the first char after the name; the same char closes. Backslash
#     escapes the delimiter and itself; every OTHER backslash is raw (so `\d` stays `\d`,
#     no doubling). Desugars to the identical token stream as the explicit call, so a
#     stack subject, a trailing opts map, and the unknown-kind error all carry over.

column3: the shortcut: subject from the stack, / delimiter
raw backslash — `\d` is the pattern, no doubling (vs the quoted '\\d')
a trailing opts map is collected by mini's 3-arg sig
a custom delimiter — | here
pick a delimiter (#) so the source can contain /
or escape the delimiter with a backslash
bf generator via the shortcut
an unknown kind is the same expansion-time error as `mini nope`
the shortcut needs the import too (no auto-import)

column1: # §7  compiled mini-languages — an optional expansion-time compile hook (design §13).
#     A kind keeps its transducer (the semantic reference + fallback) and adds a
#     compiler that runs at the `mini` site when src is concrete, splicing tokens
#     instead of the standard call. `re` ships a Go hook (precompiled-pattern
#     carrier + run-re consumer); AQL kinds add one via MiniLang.register-compiled
#     (a macro). `mini` has no expansion cache, so hooks memoize (re does).

aql:minilang import end  "aql:string-util" import end  MiniLang.register up (fn [[s:String o:Map] [String] [s]]) end  MiniLang.register-compiled up (macro [[src opts] [ quote [ unquote (StringUtil.upper src) ] ]]) end  mini up 'hi'
column3: the AQL compile hook (a macro) uppercases src at the call site

column1: aql:minilang import end  MiniLang.register-compiled ghost (macro [[s o] [ quote [ s ] ]])
column3: a compiler must layer on an existing transducer

column1: # §8  the `gex` kind — glob-expression SELECT (not a match-extractor like re).
#     Anchored whole-subject match: `*` any run, `?` one char, `**`/`*?` a literal
#     `*`/`?`. A scalar returns itself when it matches else None; a List is filtered
#     to matching elements, a Map to entries whose key matches. None / empty results
#     are falsy, so the scalar value drops straight into `if`.
